description: 枯旱預警 [drought] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集主要係提供臺灣地區供水情勢(枯旱預警)通報，依通報日期將臺灣地區分為臺北市及新北市部分地區、新北市板新地區、基隆市及新北市汐止區、新北市部分地區、桃園市及新北市林口區、新竹縣(市)、苗栗縣、臺中市及彰化縣北部地區、南投縣、彰化縣南部地區、雲林縣、嘉義縣(市)、臺南市、高雄市、屏東縣北部地區、屏東縣南部地區、宜蘭縣、花蓮縣、臺東縣... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
